emi.name: EMI (Equated Monthly Installment)
emi.simple: Approximate amount you may pay back to the bank every month
emi.detail: A fixed payment amount made by a borrower to a lender at a specified date each calendar month.

interest.name: Interest Rate
interest.simple: The extra cost charged by the bank for lending money
interest.detail: The proportion of a loan that is charged as interest to the borrower, typically expressed as an annual percentage.

principal.name: Principal Amount
principal.simple: The original amount of money you borrowed
principal.detail: The original sum of money lent or invested on which interest and payments are calculated.

tenure.name: Tenure
tenure.simple: Total number of months or years to repay the loan
tenure.detail: The agreed duration or lifespan of a loan transaction.

moratorium.name: Moratorium Period
moratorium.simple: Grace period where you do not have to pay full EMI while setting up the shop
moratorium.detail: A legally authorized period of delay in the performance of an obligation or payment of a debt.

collateral.name: Collateral / Security
collateral.simple: Land, gold, or property asked by a bank as guarantee (many schemes don't require it)
collateral.detail: An asset that a borrower offers to a lender to secure a loan.

subsidy.name: Government Subsidy
subsidy.simple: Money given by the government that you do NOT have to return if you follow scheme rules
subsidy.detail: A financial grant or concession provided by government authorities to reduce project burden.

ownContribution.name: Own Contribution (Margin Money)
ownContribution.simple: Your own cash put into the project from your savings
ownContribution.detail: The minimum proportion of the project cost that the applicant must finance from their own equity.

loanAmount.name: Loan Amount
loanAmount.simple: Money needed from the bank or financial institution
loanAmount.detail: The principal balance financed by the financial lending partner.

projectCost.name: Total Project Cost
projectCost.simple: Total money needed for machines, shop advance, initial stock, and setup
projectCost.detail: Aggregate capital expenditure and initial working capital required to launch the enterprise.

breakEven.name: Break-Even Point
breakEven.simple: Minimum sales or customers needed per day just to pay all expenses and EMI with zero loss
breakEven.detail: The sales volume at which total revenues equal total expenses, yielding zero net profit or loss.

revenue.name: Revenue
revenue.simple: Total cash received from customer sales before deducting any costs
revenue.detail: Gross incoming cash flow from the sale of goods or services.

operatingCost.name: Operating Cost
operatingCost.simple: Regular monthly expenses like raw material, electricity, transport, and shop rent
operatingCost.detail: Expenses associated with the maintenance and administration of a business on a day-to-day basis.

pilot.title: 30-Day Pre-Loan Pilot Validation Planner
pilot.subtitle: Validate actual customer demand with small experiments before committing to bank debt.
pilot.week1Desc: Talk to 25 local households. Note if they currently buy this product and what price they pay.
pilot.week2Desc: Offer test batch or sample service to 10 prospective buyers. Check if they are willing to pay cash.
pilot.week3Desc: Run a 7-day mini-trial without taking a loan, using only small own savings.
pilot.week4Desc: Count how many trial customers return for a second purchase. If repeat rate is >40%, feasibility is strong.
